source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this model may join 1 of your **GUARDIAN DEFENDERS** units that does not already have a **SUPPORT WEAPON** model joined. Until the battle ends, this model is treated as one of that **GUARDIANS** unit's models, and the Starting Strength of that unit rises to include it.

Neither this model nor any unit it has joined can embark in a **[TRANSPORT](vsdata:core-rule/transports)**.

ability.timing: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

cannotEmbark.who: this model and any unit it is joined to
